title: Among LAM segment customers who made transactions at gas stations in the Cz
question: Among LAM segment customers who made transactions at gas stations in the Czech Republic during 2012, which product description corresponds to the transaction with the highest total price?

prediction.sql:
SELECT T3."XCL_009"
FROM customers AS T1
INNER JOIN transactions_1k AS T2 ON T1."XCL_001" = T2."XCL_013"
INNER JOIN gasstations AS T4 ON T2."XCL_015" = T4."XCL_004"
INNER JOIN products AS T3 ON T2."XCL_016" = T3."XCL_008"
WHERE T1."XCL_002" = 'LAM'
  AND T4."XCL_006" = 'CZE'
  AND strftime('%Y', T2."XCL_011") = '2012'
ORDER BY T2."XCL_018" DESC
LIMIT 1
